dedupe_keys.name: ohio municipal landfill leachate volumes and surface areas 1988 2020

description: This collection digitises leachate-management reports for forty-three active or closed municipal solid-waste landfills in Ohio and surface areas for forty of them. Max Krause and collaborators transcribed Ohio EPA annual reports into monthly leachate records and annual planar-area estimates. The article reports 9,985 monthly leachate observations and 610 area observations over 1988–2020, concentrated in 2010–2020. Mendeley version 4 supplies CSV data and documentation with XLSX comparison tables, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage excludes hazardous-waste and construction-debris facilities. Missing annual reports and differences between generated, disposed, recycled, treated and stored volumes are limitations for water-balance calculations. Modellers could calibrate landfill leachate generation or estimate treatment and storage demand in waste-system simulations. model-epa-warm-waste-reduction-model is a related waste-planning resource, with a different emissions focus. The provider compares areas with greenhouse-gas reporting records, but no tables were downloaded and no area or volume values were independently checked.
